mapper.select: SELECT id, name, gender, age, major, class_name, phone, email, enrollment_date, create_time, update_time FROM student ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, gender, age, major, class_name, phone, email, enrollment_date, create_time, update_time FROM student WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (name, gender, age, major, class_name, phone, email, enrollment_date, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{major}, #{className}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{enrollmentDate}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, age = #{age}, major = #{major}, class_name = #{className}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, enrollment_date = #{enrollmentDate}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
